default: 😀 Your face makes music!
📷 Sit where the camera can see you.
😮 Open your mouth to make a sound!
😱 Open it BIG to make it LOUD!
↕️ Move your head to find new notes!
😀 ➡️ 😮 Try a smile, then an Ooh face!
🎶 Found a fun sound? Play it again!
⭐ Copy the face on screen to win points!
⏳ Hold the face still for a moment.
👫 Playing with friends? Everyone wins points!
🎯 You only need to do each face once.
🔁 Face came back? A friend is still trying it!
🤷 Too tricky? Skip it and keep playing!
🐢 No rush! Go slow and have fun.
🥁 Want drums? Turn on Beats!
👂 Play along with the drums, or stop and listen.
🎛️ Open Drum Pattern to pick a new beat!
🎭 Pick the Performance group so the drums follow you!
📈 Try Crescendo Build. The drums get bigger and BIGGER!
🥁 Try Snare Roll Build for a drum roll!
🙌 Turn on Performance so YOU control the drums!
😱 Open your mouth wide for BIG drum hits!
🔄 Turn Performance off. Now the drums play by themselves!
